Elon Musk Reclaims Trillionaire Status

Elon Musk has once again achieved trillionaire status, with his net worth reported at $1 trillion as of Monday, October 6. This marks an increase of $65.3 billion, or 6.66%, from the previous trading day, according to Forbes' real-time data. The resurgence in his wealth is attributed to SpaceX's recovery following a post-IPO slump.
